subject.title: fix: forward response-frame meta to clients

question: Should Gateway v4 accept optional top-level `res.meta` as an additive response-envelope field after this PR is rebased, or should response metadata be version-gated or relocated?
rationale: `ResponseFrameSchema` previously used `additionalProperties: false`, so strict generated clients may reject a new top-level field even though the server-side metadata path already exists.

options.title: Accept additive `res.meta`
options.body: Resolve the current conflict, keep the optional field documented as additive to v4, and rely on clients ignoring metadata they do not use.

options.title: Version or relocate metadata
options.body: Pause this PR and require a version-gated or payload-level metadata contract if maintainers do not want new top-level response fields in v4.

recommendation.title: Accept additive `res.meta`
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflict, keep the optional field documented as additive to v4, and rely on clients ignoring metadata they do not use.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is tied to the shared request-handler type surface and recent gateway/protocol-adjacent release history, making him the best available routing owner for the compatibility call.
